$comment: Reviewed packages whose licence is not in ADR 0011's permissive tier; checked by licences.test.js with frontend/scripts/licences.ts. These are CI tools that are never distributed with TART (ADR 0021). Each entry records the exact licence, so a licence change upstream needs a new review.

npm.reason: Installed only because semantic-release depends on @semantic-release/npm; the npm plugin is not configured, so npm never runs, and it is never distributed. Needs a person's confirmation of the tier.

spdx-exceptions.reason: A data list of SPDX licence exceptions, read by semantic-release's tooling in CI; never distributed.

spdx-license-ids.reason: A public-domain data list of SPDX licence ids, read by semantic-release's tooling in CI; never distributed.
